text:
```yaml
name: Go Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test -v -race ./...

      - name: Run vet
        run: go vet ./...
```
